text:
Amanda: Heads-up — saw a small spike in structured-output rejections for function 'summarize_document' in eu-west. Console marks them as "reject" which increments strict-validate quota. Many look like missing optional fields (eg. "confidence"). Can we route these to a permissive variant instead of charging?

Jon: Do we actually have telemetry that splits optional vs required failures? If we route permissive we risk hiding regressions.

Amanda: Quick example of the payload we got:
```
{
  "summary": "Short TL;DR of the doc",
  "confidence": null
}
```
This fails validation because "confidence" is null vs omitted. Semantically it's fine.

Selina: Where is "soft-reject" defined today? Console currently only shows "reject" vs "accept". We need a third state + quick access to samples.

Mike: We do have a reject reason string in telemetry but it's sampled at 1% by default. Proposal: increase sampling to 10% for the next 24h for this function and add a new dashboard panel "rejects by reason".

validation-bot: validation-bot observed 112 rejects in last 1h for summarize_document|eu-west (ids: aa3f..., bb7c...).

Jon: Two choices: A) route to permissive variant (same model, validate=false) and mark route as "degraded" but keep billing unchanged. B) keep strict, count a reject, and surface full samples to console + alert owners.

Selina: Billing will push back on silently accepting rejects. Compromise: accept but tag as "soft-accept" and bill at a lower tier until owners flip the policy.

Amanda: My proposal: add a routing policy type "soft-route" with fields: matchers, sample_rate, billing_tier. Console UX should show a "soft-accept" column with a "promote" button to make it strict. Who owns the server-side change?

Mike: I'll add telemetry + dashboard work (deltas only). Need an API change for route policy proto. Jon, can you add the gating in the router? I can wire the console bits once we have the API.

Jon: Will open a quick RFC/PR today. Implementation detail: prefer to add a response-level flag rather than mutate incoming headers. Suggest response field: "validation_status": "soft-accept" | "hard-reject" | "ok".

Selina: Also ensure samples are PII-redacted before storing. Add a redact pipeline step.

Amanda: Tagging @Nate from billing — please chime in.

Nate: We prefer an explicit billing flag. If "soft-accept" reduces charge, we need a price delta defined. Otherwise we'll keep billing as-is and will audit usage.

Amanda: :thumbsup: OK — sync at 15:00 to finalize policy and rollout plan.

Mike: I'll push a dashboard PR after the RFC lands. Jon please assign me the sampling change.

Jon: Done. RFC link: https://redwood/s/rfc/soft-route (WIP).
